async def act(page):
    # List to store titles of opened issues with 'enhancement' label
    opened_feature_issues = []
    
    # Get all issue links under the main section
    main_section = page.get_by_role('main')
    all_links = main_section.get_by_role('link')
    link_count = await all_links.count()
    
    for i in range(link_count):
        link = all_links.nth(i)
        href = await link.get_attribute('href')
        if href and href.startswith('/root/metaseq/-/issues/'):
            # Get the issue title text
            issue_title = await link.text_content()
            # Find the next sibling 'Labels' group for this issue
            labels_groups = main_section.get_by_role('group', name='Labels')
            group_count = await labels_groups.count()
            for j in range(group_count):
                group = labels_groups.nth(j)
                # Check if this group contains a link with name 'enhancement'
                enhancement_link = group.get_by_role('link', name='enhancement')
                if await enhancement_link.count() > 0:
                    opened_feature_issues.append(issue_title)
                    break
    
    # Output the list as a string, one per line
    result = '\n'.join(opened_feature_issues)
    return result
